scope: Non-advisor src/lib utilities, src/types, src/i18n, build/configuration, scripts; shared calculation/knowledge/advisor logic belongs to sibling reviews.

semantics.read: Human inspection of substantive source and boundary handling.
semantics.targeted_read: Selected source sections and callsites inspected; whole file also scanned.
semantics.scanned: Inventory, boundary patterns and applicable syntax/function checks only; no claim of complete semantic review.

findings.before: Deletes old patch files before fetching or validating a new release; same-patch writes overwrite good files before validation.
findings.change: Fetch sources first, build/validate in staging, copy advisor inputs, publish manifest last with patch rollback, prune numeric patch folders only after success.

findings.before: Deletes all old image directories, including unrelated directories, before downloads succeed.
findings.change: Stage images and spriteSheets.ts/assetVersion.ts together, reject download/empty-sheet failures, rollback publication failures, prune numeric versions after successful installation. Split collection, image transforms, sheet output and publication by responsibility.
findings.pixelEvidence: Sharp fixtures verify literal colors at champion/item cell centers and Q/E slots, 96px champion cells, 320x64 five-slot strips, AVIF width and generated TypeScript ids.

findings.before: Equal file length causes obsolete runtime contents to be reused after an SDK change.
findings.change: Check SHA-256 when sizes match; copy changed contents while avoiding rewriting identical files.

findings.before: Without version.json, patch fallback compares only the minor patch and picks 25.24 over 26.1.
findings.change: Use numeric comparison for complete year.patch strings.

findings.before: EOF without a done:true completion record returns a partial answer as success.
findings.change: Reject incomplete streams and preserve complete answer tokens and durations.

verification.TypeScriptAST: 254 initial source files, zero parse errors; four new modules pass scripts typecheck.
verification.PythonAST: 110 files, zero parse errors; model/training code was not executed.
verification.i18n: 393 strings per locale, identical key sets; three placeholder differences were checked at their callsites and are intentional (Korean particles and literal stack placeholders).
commands: node --import tsx --test tests/unit/llm-script-recovery.test.ts tests/unit/prepare-ort.test.ts tests/unit/static-data-publication.test.ts tests/unit/thumbnail-publication.test.ts tests/data/thumbnails.test.ts
scoped ESLint --max-warnings 0 for modified scripts/new tests

remaining.status: source-boundary observation, not reproduced in an installed PWA upgrade
remaining.issue: Fixed ort/models URLs use CacheFirst cooldown-advisor-runtime-v1 for 30 days; SDK/runtime cache versioning needs a dedicated upgrade/offline reproduction before any change.

limitations: GPU/model training, external Ollama servers, paid evaluators, remote jobs and real upstream downloads were not run.
Research scripts marked scanned are not a complete semantic line-by-line human audit.
Tests used isolated temporary directories and mock network streams; real public/data, public/img and generated TypeScript indexes were not generated.
Staging protects ordinary fetch/validation/publication failures, not an arbitrary process crash across filesystem renames or concurrent independent generation processes.
One existing buildSheet signature keeps seven related image/layout/cache arguments; it was moved intact rather than widening the refactor scope.

deliveryGate.hard: PASS for owned non-UI scope: no product UI or user design assets changed; new outputs occur only after successful generation/validation.
deliveryGate.purpose: PASS: staging prevents proven data loss; content hash prevents proven stale runtime; each new comment explains a failure or boundary.
deliveryGate.liveliness: PASS for non-UI scope: existing product imagery, sprite ordering, geometry and compression remain unchanged; no visual design was generated.
deliveryGate.craft: PASS: 31 focused/real-data checks pass, pixel-level sprite checks pass, scoped lint and scripts typecheck pass; audit coverage explicitly distinguishes read from scanned.
